name: hausvermietung-lustenau
description: A blank template to get started with Payload 3.0

scripts.test: pnpm run test:int && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:prepare && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./hausvermietung-lustenau.e2e.db PAYLOAD_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-not-for-production ENABLE_PUBLIC_INQUIRIES=true NODE_OPTIONS="--no-deprecation --import=tsx/esm" playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:prepare: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./hausvermietung-lustenau.e2e.db PAYLOAD_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-not-for-production NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation tsx src/scripts/reset-e2e-database.ts && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./hausvermietung-lustenau.e2e.db PAYLOAD_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-not-for-production NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation payload migrate && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./hausvermietung-lustenau.e2e.db PAYLOAD_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-not-for-production NODE_ENV=production tsx src/scripts/seed-content.ts
scripts.test:int: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./hausvermietung-lustenau.integration.db PAYLOAD_SECRET=integration-test-secret-not-for-production NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation payload migrate && cross-env PAYLOAD_SECRET=integration-test-secret-not-for-production NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mts
